lines.en: Watch the champion's stride.
My cape trails behind me.
Belt tight, presence steady.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是为了让镜头跟上
lines.en: I walk slow so the cameras keep up.
I know this street well.
Every step lands on the beat.
This is how an Earth fighter walks.
Out of the way, crowd.
The ground shakes where I tread.
My muscles arrive before I do.
Heading your way; do not panic.
I warm up as I walk.
Standing here is already a show.
Look at this stance; textbook.
Let me adjust my gloves.
Where is my audience?
I hold still; my presence does not.
Deep breath; gathering power.
I could hold this pose all day.
This smile is trained.
Mr. Satan never shows fear.
Shoulders loose, fists not.
I am waiting for the referee.
This breeze is nothing.
I go in at the count of three.
That pose just now? Stylish, right?
You are staring; good taste.
Recognize me? Earth's champion.
Come closer, no need to be shy.

lines.zh: 我这身打扮值一个签名
lines.en: This outfit is worth an autograph.
You look like a fan.
Want to challenge me? Get in line.
I am facing you; look closely.
Could you take this fist?
The name is Satan. Remember it.

lines.zh: 别抖，我又不会马上动手
lines.en: Do not tremble; I will not strike yet.

lines.zh: 你也有几分练过的样子
lines.en: You look like you have trained some.

lines.zh: 我在你身上看不到怯场
lines.en: I see no stage fright in you.
Stance first; presence wins first.

lines.zh: 你的影子挡住了我的光
lines.en: Your shadow is blocking my light.
I give you three seconds to prepare.
Everyone is watching; do not embarrass yourself.

lines.zh: 我这一身伤疤都是故事
lines.en: Every scar here is a story.
You blinked; half your presence is gone.
Hmph, that had some weight.
Only a little skin scraped.
Champions feel pain but do not fall.
You actually sucker-punched me!
I step back and reset my stance.
I will remember that punch.
My glove is crooked now.
It hurts, but my spirit cannot lose.
Come on, I am not even warm yet.
Is this an offering for me?
Even champions eat.
Leave it; I will eat after the fight.
You know your manners.
I smell meat.
Good food needs good drink.
I pat my belly: accepted.
Do not think food buys me.
This bite counts as pre-fight fuel.
Want some? My treat.
You bumped the champion. Careful.
This frame is not a wall.
You nearly fell; I caught you.
Collision test: I win.
You are sturdier than you look.
No shoving; line up for photos.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你退了两步
lines.en: I did not move; you fell back two steps.
Steady, citizen.
That collision was loud.
Watch where you walk next time.
The champion's private life stays private.
Too many cameras for this.
I have fans to think of.
Asking about my love life?
Win this match first.
My charm is admittedly hard to resist.
Not a topic for a fight.
I always respect my opponents.
A champion must keep his image.
Do not misunderstand; I am only warming up.

lines.zh: 这是谁掉的，我捡起来了
lines.en: Someone dropped this; I picked it up.
Even champions do good deeds.
Take it back; no need to cheer.
Even my bending over looks good.
Picking things up is basic training.
Yours; keep it safe.
I still have one hand free.
Do not look at me like that.
Next time pick it up yourself.
Fine, you are the one this round.
I have you locked; no slipping away.
Take your stance; begin.
Audience, kindly step back.
I see your opening.
I intend to win this one beautifully.
Your steps look weak.
I will let you have three moves.
A champion's instinct is never wrong.
I am watching your shoulder.

lines.zh: 气聚起来，拳头也聚起来
lines.en: Gathering ki, and gathering my fist.
You are my opponent now.
Do not flinch; fight with honor.
This blow will make the highlight reel.
I will shout before I swing.
Ready, citizen?
I am on your left; watch.
Three hundred health is plenty to chase you down.
My footwork is not that good.
No circling; face me.
I am matching your rhythm.

lines.zh: 你的手在护头，我知道了
lines.en: You are guarding your head; noted.
I am hunting your center of gravity.
Changing direction will not help.
I am pushing you to the wall.
Ki down, feet planted.
You show openings when rushed.
We are fighters, not butchers.
One more step back and you are cornered.

lines.zh: 我出拳前会先吸一口气
lines.en: I take a breath before I swing.

lines.zh: 你已经在我拳头范围里
lines.en: You are already in my range.
Do not look at the crowd.
A champion does not strike from behind.
Watch this punch!
Satan Iron Fist; take it.
Twenty years went into this blow.
It lands on your shoulder, solid.
Fist meets flesh; the crowd roars.
Do not underestimate an Earthling.
I pose after I strike.
That one will stay with you a while.
You fell back three steps and held.
Just enough force; not lethal.
Take another of these fists.
Your armor took it; a shame.

lines.zh: 再来一下，我看你能撑几次
lines.en: Again; let us see how many you take.
This blow is a champion's pride.
I am not using full strength.
The champion arrives; clear the way!

lines.zh: 让开让开，撒旦先生来了
lines.en: Make way; Mr. Satan is here.
This place needed a hero.
Am I too late to the fight?
The mood changes when I arrive.
Do not fear; I am here.
Who is causing trouble here?
These muscles are not decoration.
Where on earth is the stage?
Step aside; the lead has arrived.
I heard someone calling for help.
The energy here is not bad.

lines.zh: 我一出现，问题就解决一半
lines.en: My arrival solves half the problem.
No applause yet; it has not started.

lines.zh: 我带着冠军的气场来的
lines.en: I brought a champion's presence.
Who wants to see real strength?
Clear the crowd; I am starting.
Who is the opponent this time?
Fire caught my cape.
Falling like that is embarrassing.
Water went up my nose.
Who shot that arrow from behind?
This is plainly crooked sorcery.
Even a champion must eat.
Struck by lightning? I was not boasting.
This place does not even have ground.
